# soulsensis

> Essays on the tiredness of performing a life, and the way home to contentment, inner peace and life satisfaction. Written by a human, published anonymously as soulsensis. The book: Sit Still Enough to Hear It (Essays on the tiredness of performing a life, and the way home to contentment).

## The book

- [Sit Still Enough to Hear It](https://soulsensis.com/book.html): twenty essays in six chapters on comparison, wanting, the shadow, blame, attention, surrender and contentment. Not self-help steps; one person thinking honestly from inside their own life.
- The book is coming soon as a trilogy.

## Topics (the book's chapters)

- [Chapter 1: A fraction of who I am](https://soulsensis.com/essays.html#chapter-1): Comparison, living by someone else's script, and the wanting and waiting that keep you small.
- [Chapter 2: Behind lucid eyes](https://soulsensis.com/essays.html#chapter-2): Facing what hurts instead of hiding it: dark thoughts, the shadow, friendships that end, and seasons that pass.
- [Chapter 3: Water the grass in front of you](https://soulsensis.com/essays.html#chapter-3): Dropping blame, framing events as neutral, choosing where attention goes, and seeing that identity can change fast.
- [Chapter 4: The cost of fighting yourself](https://soulsensis.com/essays.html#chapter-4): The addiction to stress and resistance, and why becoming yourself is the simplest and the most demanding thing.
- [Chapter 5: Sit still enough to hear it](https://soulsensis.com/essays.html#chapter-5): No longer trying to shine, stepping aside from wanting, and coming home to the quiet voice underneath.
- [Chapter 6: Contentment, the only destination](https://soulsensis.com/essays.html#chapter-6): Living it: presence, meaning found by acting in the world, and a soul that was never broken.
